description: This is a shell script file that contains test functions for verifying git diff output and change contexts within a project, including setup of test conditions, diff generation, and validation of diff content.

methods.name: commit_and_tag
methods.description: Creates a git commit with the specified tag after adding files and setting the timestamp.

methods.name: first_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the first line of context after the diff hunk header.

methods.name: last_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the last line of context from the diff.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff for a specified file and verifies that the patch applies correctly.
